name: Ali ibn Abi Talib
bio: The First Imam, cousin and son-in-law of the Prophet. Born inside the Kaaba, he was among the earliest believers and is remembered for knowledge, justice, and courage. His caliphate (35–40 AH) was dominated by civil wars that shaped later Islamic history.

events.name: Birth in Kaaba
events.desc: Born inside the Holy Kaaba in Mecca, a unique distinction.

events.name: Early acceptance of Islam
events.desc: Accepted Islam in childhood and grew up in the Prophet's household.

events.name: Night of Hijra (Laylat al-Mabit)
events.desc: Slept in the Prophet's bed during the Hijra plot and returned trusts to their owners.

events.name: Battle of Badr
events.desc: Fought at Badr—first major battle of Islam.

events.name: Marriage to Fatimah
events.desc: Married Lady Fatimah al-Zahra; the Imams descend through them.

events.name: Battle of Uhud
events.desc: Defended the Prophet during the setback at Uhud.

events.name: Battle of Khandaq
events.desc: Dueled and defeated Amr ibn Abd Wudd at the Trench.

events.name: Conquest of Khaybar
events.desc: Key role in the capture of Khaybar.

events.name: Ghadir Khumm
events.desc: Present at Ghadir Khumm where the Prophet declared Wilayah.

events.name: Caliphate
events.desc: Accepted the Caliphate after Uthman's death.

events.name: Capital to Kufa
events.desc: Transferred the capital from Medina to Kufa.

events.name: Battle of Siffin
events.desc: Protracted conflict against Mu'awiyah; ended in arbitration.

events.name: Martyrdom
events.desc: Struck in Kufa Mosque; died on 21 Ramadan.

name: Hasan ibn Ali
bio: The Second Imam. He assumed leadership after Imam Ali and faced Mu'awiyah's military pressure. His treaty aimed to prevent civil bloodshed and preserve the community.

events.name: Kufa
events.desc: Moved with Imam Ali to Kufa when it became the capital.

events.name: Peace Treaty
events.desc: Treaty with Mu'awiyah to avoid war.

events.name: Return to Medina
events.desc: Returned to Medina, focusing on teaching and charity.

name: Husayn ibn Ali
bio: The Third Imam. Refused allegiance to Yazid and rose to protect the moral core of Islam. His martyrdom at Karbala became the defining symbol of resistance to tyranny.

events.name: Imamate
events.desc: Assumed Imamate after Imam Hasan's martyrdom.

events.name: Refusal of Bay'ah
events.desc: Refused to pledge allegiance to Yazid.

events.name: Stay in Mecca
events.desc: Went to Mecca and remained there for months.

events.name: Muslim b. Aqil in Kufa
events.desc: Sent Muslim ibn Aqil to assess support; he was later killed.

name: Ali ibn Husayn
bio: The Fourth Imam. Survivor of Karbala who guided the community through spiritual renewal, prayers, and ethical teaching under Umayyad repression.

events.name: Captivity in Kufa
events.desc: Taken captive to Kufa after Karbala.

events.name: Sermon in Damascus
events.desc: Addressed the public in Damascus, clarifying the tragedy.

events.name: Sahifa Sajjadiya
events.desc: Legacy of supplications shaping Shi'i spirituality (approx. period of teaching).

name: Muhammad al-Baqir
bio: The Fifth Imam. Expanded teaching circles in Medina and laid foundations for systematic jurisprudence and theology.

events.name: Journey to Damascus
events.desc: Summoned to Damascus; engaged in debates.

events.name: Medina teaching circle
events.desc: Major period of disseminating hadith and jurisprudence.

name: Ja'far al-Sadiq
bio: The Sixth Imam. Formalized the Ja'fari school; taught during the Umayyad-Abbasid transition.

events.name: Abbasid Revolution
events.desc: Witnessed Umayyad fall and Abbasid rise.

events.name: Scholarly peak
events.desc: Peak teaching period; transmission of hadith and legal principles.

name: Musa al-Kazim
bio: The Seventh Imam. Known for patience; endured repeated imprisonments under Abbasid caliphs.

events.name: Arrest & transfer
events.desc: Arrested and moved from Medina toward Iraq.

name: Ali al-Rida
bio: The Eighth Imam. Forced into the Abbasid court as heir-apparent; known for debates and the Golden Chain narration.

name: Muhammad al-Jawad
bio: The Ninth Imam. Became Imam at a young age; known for public debates and integrity under Abbasid surveillance.

events.name: Debate in Baghdad
events.desc: Public debate with Yahya ibn Aktham (reported) demonstrating knowledge.

name: Ali al-Hadi
bio: The Tenth Imam. Forced to Samarra and kept under surveillance; strengthened the network of representatives.

events.name: Exile to Samarra
events.desc: Moved to Samarra by order of the Abbasid caliph.

events.name: House arrest period
events.desc: Long years of close surveillance; guidance via deputies.

name: Hasan al-Askari
bio: The Eleventh Imam. Lived in the military garrison of Samarra under surveillance and prepared the community for the Occultation.

events.name: Birth of Imam Mahdi
events.desc: Birth of his son occurred under secrecy (reported in Samarra).

name: Muhammad al-Mahdi
bio: The Twelfth Imam. Entered Minor Occultation in 260 AH with communication through appointed deputies, then Major Occultation began in 329 AH.

events.name: 1st Deputy
events.desc: Uthman ibn Sa'id begins deputyship (commonly associated with Baghdad/Samarra).
